scenes.name: AC/DC
scenes.book: Heavy Metal: The Music and Its Culture
scenes.author: Deena Weinstein
scenes.desc: «Let There Be Rock» es para Weinstein el texto paradigmático sobre la genealogía del rock vista desde el heavy: el blues (sin pretensiones) recibe una inyección de sentimentalismo pop y nace un híbrido con sus propias cualidades, que llega como un concierto: primero el sonido, luego las luces, luego la batería y la guitarra. Su rayo en el logotipo (idea sacada, dice la tradición, de la máquina de coser de la hermana de Angus Young) y discos como High Voltage y Powerage explotan la imagen de la energía eléctrica. Es el gran cantor del sexo festivo y sin compromiso («Whole Lotta Rosie», «Shoot to Thrill») y del infierno como fiesta («Highway to Hell», «Hell Ain’t a Bad Place to Be»).

podcast.title: Death from Dementia Complications
podcast.body: Malcolm Young ultimately died from complications arising from dementia on November 18, 2017, at the age of 64. His cognitive decline severely impacted his ability to continue his musical career in the years leading up to his passing. "He died of complications resulting from dementia on November 18th, 2017 at the age of 64."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Multiple Health Issues and Dementia
podcast.body: Malcolm Young, the rhythm guitarist for AC/DC, faced a series of severe health problems throughout his later years. These included lung cancer and heart issues that necessitated a pacemaker. By April 2014, his cognitive function had deteriorated significantly, rendering him unable to perform with the band. "First it was lung cancer, then it was heart problems that required a pacemaker."
